en: Don't mind me, or my smell...because I sure don't!
Charge!!! Run 'em through!

There's something out there. Let loose a warning round!
I, Arynia Cloudsbreak, have been tasked with protecting the sanctity of the Oracle Grove.
May this prisoner's death serve as a warning.  None shall defy the scourge and live!
Does my name sound familiar to you? Maybe we knew each other a long time ago...$B$BI think I'm named after someone important...
Why not destroy them with the combined might of the Aspects?
My charge to watch the temple has failed... my corrupted soul knows no peace...
You are well on your way, $n.  But you still have much to learn.  The southern Barrens may be where your next lesson is found.
I hope you're here to work, $C.  We have a lot to do and the Horde, the Syndicate and the Ogres aren't going to help us.
Seek out Miao'zan in Sen'jin Village to the south.
$n has defended the farm!
KILL!!!
Jubjub?  Where are you, Jubjub?  Oh no!  Where did you go this time!
Welcome to Caer Darrow, stranger.

I'm as sane as the next guy, $g fella:lady;. Believe what you will, but I AM capable of fashioning this armor. If you're interested, maybe we can make a deal. The sooner I can get out of the assassination business, the better.
Good people of Goldshire, come take advantage of my incredible prices on rare goods. I shall not return for some time!
%s begins to combine different colored crystals together.
Well, well. Looks like we got ourselves some competition. Get 'em boys!
Welcome back to the Great Forge, $n. Ye come to visit an old Dwarf or do ye think yer ready for the next step in yer training?
I wish to become an armorsmith.
I submit myself for further training my master.
%s is released and now bound to you, $n.
Oh well....
What want from Raze??
Can you imagine?
Good luck, $n!
You need to start learning things that are beyond my expertise! Talk to Lilliam Sparkspindle in front of the tent there. He'll set you on the right course!

Captain Balinda Stonehearth leads the front line Alliance forces.  She is based in the Stonehearth Outpost, in the northern section of the Field of Strife.$B$BBalinda has not yet reentered the battle.
